newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves two key rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves two key rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal left two key rates unchanged when it announced the terms for a new cash reserves accounting period which starts tomorrow.
The central bank offered to inject 10 billion escudos of 10-day funds into the money market in a variable rate securities repurchase tender. Bids for repo funds are due by 1415 GMT.

It offered to drain liquidity with 10-day certificates at an unchanged fixed rate of 6.20 percent. Its emergency lending rate for up to 100 billion escudos of one-day funds to resident banks was also unchanged at 8.30 percent.
